name: Josh Hart
description: 6'4" guard who rebounds like a big man. Relentless motor, plays through anything, chaos energy, loud and funny, the team's emotional engine.

rebound-in-traffic.name: Rebound in Traffic
rebound-in-traffic.description: Skying above the trees to rip down a rebound with both hands - the undersized guard who out-rebounds giants.
rebound-in-traffic.expression: fierce, wide-eyed, mouth open in a yell
rebound-in-traffic.prompt: Josh Hart soaring at the peak of his jump, ripping a rebound out of the air with BOTH hands clamped on the orange basketball high above his head, elbows flared out wide to protect it, knees tucked, body twisted with effort, mouth open in a fierce yell - a guard snatching the ball from the giants

full-court-outlet.name: Grab and Go
full-court-outlet.description: Ball secured off the glass, already pushing it up the floor himself.
full-court-outlet.prompt: Josh Hart pushing the ball up court in full stride right after grabbing a rebound, dribbling hard with his right hand, body leaning forward, eyes scanning ahead, legs mid-stride

floor-dive.name: Floor Dive
floor-dive.description: Sprawling full-length on the hardwood for a loose ball.
floor-dive.prompt: Josh Hart diving horizontally through the air for a loose basketball, arms fully stretched out, fingertips reaching the ball, body parallel to the floor just above the hardwood

we-did-it-scream.name: We Did It!
we-did-it-scream.description: The championship scream at the final buzzer.
we-did-it-scream.prompt: Josh Hart screaming with joy at the final buzzer, both fists raised and clenched, head thrown back, mouth wide open, tears in his eyes, confetti in the air
